# vöré

## Infinitive

| Dialett | Italiano | English |
|---|---|---|
| **vöré** | volere | to want |

| Gerundio † | Participio passato | Verb class |
|---|---|---|
| vurendo | vurüü | 2nd conjugation: infinitive in -é (Italian -ere, stressed ending) |
